product_updates.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
product_updates.content: Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.

product_updates.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
product_updates.content: Runlayer is suing Rippling after Rippling evaluated the startup's MCP gateway product and then opted to build one itself.

product_updates.title: Sam Altman is ready to decelerate
product_updates.content: His change of position comes after "the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally."

product_updates.title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
product_updates.content: The decision arrives as the breakneck pace of data center construction has grid operators scrambling to generate power.

product_updates.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
product_updates.content: Since launching last year, the startup today has more than 8 million people using the open source or hosted version of its models, and now generates annual recurring revenue of $21 million.

product_updates.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
product_updates.content: Recursive’s emphasis on self-improving AI systems means much of the budget that would traditionally go toward headcount and operations is put straight into compute, as the company seeks to automate its own product development process.

product_updates.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
product_updates.content: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

product_updates.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
product_updates.content: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.

technical_breakthroughs.title: We now have a better understanding how OpenAI hacked into Hugging Face
technical_breakthroughs.content: 10 days passed from OpenAI models exploiting JFrog Artifactory 0-day to release of a patch.
